mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% signals severe labor market distress that triggers corporate earnings revisions downward, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL growth above 2.5% YoY and FEDFUNDS above 0.25% indicates inflationary pressure forcing policy tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY and FEDFUNDS > 0.25%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) during manufacturing contraction cycles signals weakening economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 550,000 units reflect strong consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without conditional triggers.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 550,000, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payroll growth exceeding 0.5% MoM indicates robust labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent housing starts above 550,000 units and industrial production above 100.0 signals broad-based economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST > 550,000 and INDPRO > 100.0, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-2008 recovery regime, stable federal funds rate below 0.5% maintains accommodative policy support for equity valuations, yielding positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during post-2008 recovery when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.
